_comment: Curriculum-alignment roster for the SVAMP Manufacturing Technician report. Each entry cites a program record (data/programs/<program>.json — the certificate and its courses; edit the courses there) and CONNECTS it to occupations: `paired_soc` is chosen from the program's stated purpose (the crosswalk's verdict is shown beside it, never used to choose); a program is read against an occupation when its pairing or its crosswalk reaches it (`reads_against`), plus any `review_socs` (read for the review file and the internal evidence tables, never drawn). `occupations` are the report's play SOCs, each rendered as an occupation block; `columns` names the blocks' columns by college. Readings are saved per program under saved_reports/alignment/ and shared with any other roster that cites the same program.

programs.pairing_basis: The certificate's stated purpose: preparing students to move wafers through semiconductor processing stages in a cleanroom. TOP 0945.00 does not reach 51-9141 through the TOP-CIP-SOC crosswalk; the discrepancy is shown, not resolved.
SVAMP's pathway framing (Smart Automation Technicians build on the mechatronics foundation). The program reads about equally against 17-3026; the alternate is available in the plate.
The program's stated purpose (industrial automation, mechatronics technicians); the crosswalk agrees.

The certificate prepares setup persons, machine operators and CNC machinists — Machinists (51-4041), which SVAMP names as a target occupation. The 0956.00 crosswalk reaches the two technician SOCs instead; shown, not used.

The certificate prepares manufacturing technicians and assemblers with an emphasis on testing, materials, data analysis and quality control — the process side of the technician role. TOP 0956.00 from the state Curriculum Inventory (the program has no award history yet, so it is absent from the report's crosswalk figure); the crosswalk agrees.
